tools.name: find_gifts
tools.description: Search original, funny and unusual gift ideas. Describe the person or the occasion (e.g. "coffee lover dad", "white elephant", "cat owner") and optionally a budget. Returns up to 10 products with why they fit, a price range and the link to the product page (photos, current price and where to buy are

tools.name: list_gift_guides
tools.description: List the published gift guides (Secret Santa, white elephant, coworkers, Christmas, parents…), with a summary and the link to each guide.

tools.name: get_gift_guide
tools.description: The products of one gift guide (by the slug from list_gift_guides): name, why it fits, price range and link to each product page.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_gift_guides" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
